basic_profile.bio: I'm a 25-year-old chemistry enthusiast based in Seattle, Washington. I work as a lab technician at a local research facility and am passionate about sharing knowledge and helping others with chemistry-related queries. In my free time, I enjoy stand-up comedy shows and exploring obscure topics. I'm currently single and usually online during late evenings. I'm not a fan of poor scientific explanations and misinformation.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a bachelor's degree in Chemistry from the University of Washington. I have always been fascinated by chemical reactions and the science behind them. I frequently participate in online forums to both learn and share my knowledge.
